message: Agent registration partially succeeded: audit log shows registration event, but agent record is not retrievable (404 on /agents/:agent_id). Agent may exist but is not properly activated or approved.
Token issuance recorded in audit log; authentication completed successfully.
Agent never accessed the API registry (no GET requests to /apis endpoint). Cannot proceed with onboarding without discovering the test API details.
No access request was filed. Agent did not attempt to request toolkit access, likely blocked by failure to complete find-credential task.

Test API received 25 GET requests, but no execution records exist in the platform. Requests bypassed the broker entirely, indicating agent made direct calls instead of proxied requests through Jentic.
